name: Living Concourse
notes: Station interiors keep the 2:1 isometric camera but read as built architecture: metal floor panels, door frames, hangar mouth, railings, and rim light.
Kiosks, crates, benches, shuttle, and crew have clearer materials, contact shadows, and less of the toy-block silhouette.
Desks, hangar launch, hull collision, and screen-space walking are unchanged. Planet sites stay overhead.
